lines.en: It’s a new day, which means there is a new night on the way. Then, once that happens, there will be another new day on the way and I can say this all again tomorrow.
Then again the next. And again the next. Forever and ever and ever because there can be no end in sight when I’ve grown blind to the ticking of a clock that never does.
Good morning. My name is Akira Arakawa, I’m 31 years old, and I’m ready to ruin somebody’s life and/or day.
Oh, look. And right on cue. There’s my latest victim now.
I tap a button on my phone and have a large penis. It’s so awesome being me.
: Hello?
: Hi! Guess who has her phone again?
: Oh, cool. But also not cool because I kind of figured you’d have picked up right where you left off when Rika took yours away.
: You mean sending you nudes in the heat of a horny rampage and then begging for you to come ravage my body like a raptor plucking strips of meat off of a dying animal?
: What happened to the silverback gorilla thing?
: I learned their penises are really small. Such a shame, really. Having a figure like that and then just a toothpick down below? I’d probably snap it off the way I am now.
: Are raptor penises larger?
: I don’t know. I’m kind of scared to Google it. But that doesn’t matter because I’m NOT looking to have sex today!
I hang up the phone. I don’t have time for this.
: Hah...
: Hello?
: You hung up the phone! Don’t act like you’re only in this for my body after several years of mutual lusting! Come hang out!
: Wow, yeah. It sounds really fun spending the whole day wanting to have sex with each other and then not doing it.
: Is that not what you do when you hang out with Miss Watabe and her girlfriend? Or any of the other girls you’re not having sex with because of reasons?
: I’m just messing with you, Rin. What do you want to do?
: Mall! I have money now and I’m not afraid to use it!
: Oh, right. It just opened back up, didn’t it? Do you want to just meet there or something?
: Yes, but only because I’m already here. Under normal circumstances, I’d meet you halfway. Today, you come to me.
: I think you’re supposed to wait until making plans with someone to start fulfilling those plans, Rin.
: I think you’re supposed to just do what I tell you because that’s what homies do.
: Does that work both ways?
: Everything about me works both ways.
: Then let’s make out later.
: Word. See you soon!
: See you soon...
I hang up the phone and...get dressed, I guess. And, for once, I have morning plans with Rin that don’t involve me heading over to Koi Cafe first.
It’s fine, though. I’ll just make her buy me coffee at the mall since she has money now and “isn’t afraid to use it.”
I’m sure that she’ll feel very good about this and won’t feel like I’m leveraging my relationship with her to earn material goods at all?
Anyway, I’ll check back in an hour or so when I’m-
: Hey!
: Oh. I guess I’m already here.
: Seems like pretty much everybody is. I haven’t seen the mall this busy since Black Ops 2 came out and I think I was only like 6 for that.
: Is that a movie or something?
: Are you sure you’re in your thirties, Sensei? Because you sure seem to say a lot of stuff that makes me question the legitimacy of that.
: I’m pretty sure just not having a social media account or any actual interests puts me a couple decades behind everyone.
: Spares you the risk of getting cancelled at least. You’re like prime cancelling material too, so I doubt you’d last long anyway.
: What does that even mean? I’ve heard it before.
: It’s basically when a bunch of people online decide that you suck and then nothing else happens and everyone goes on with their lives.
: Oh. That’s what people are afraid of nowadays?
: I don’t get it either. But, from what I understand, I’m much closer to a depiction of teenagers from your generation than I am from mine. Weird. I wonder why?
: I imagine you just take after your moms. They seemed to have been pretty influential given how you all really like girls.
: Did you just imply that my bisexuality is a choice or the result of my upbringing? I’m going to cancel you right here and now, dude. That’s it. You’re cancelled.
: I feel no different.
: But I bet a bunch of people think you do. So...take that.
: Right, yeah. So how much more of this until we get to the making out part?
: We could make out right now if you don’t mind a bunch of weird older guys who smell vaguely like chlorine watching us?
: Oh, good. So I’m not the only one who smells that. I’m glad I’m not having a stroke.
: I thought toast was the stroke smell?
: Then we’re in trouble because I smell that too.
: That’s probably just the new bakery that opened up. There was an older guy in there who kept screaming about corn flakes, so I think they’re just trying to figure out how to make them?
: I don’t think they’re doing it correctly.
: I don’t think they’re doing anything correctly because I ordered a scone and wound up with grilled squid instead. Probably just misheard me. Opening day woes, you know?
: There’s a pretty drastic difference in the pronunciation of those words, Rin.
: It’s much less drastic in English. And, for all we know, there are a bunch of people watching us through a screen right now where our dialogue is translated into that.
: Well, I hope they don’t watch everything because it’s going to be hard surviving cancellation after making out with a teenager later.
: I’ll be fine, at least. You can get away with all sorts of stuff by being a cute girl. It’s about time I went viral, you know.
: However! There is more exploring to do before our tongues wind up in each other’s mouths! And I still need to go pick up the latest Days to Waste album, so you’re coming with me!
: Can I at least get my coffee first?
: Only the bakery has coffee right now and I don’t want to be around the corn flakes guy so you’re going to have to wait! To the music shop! Away!
: Corn flakes!
: Now, now dear. We already got your corn flakes. We’re here for the latest Days to Waste album. Remember?
: Forget me when the summer ends!
: There is no escape. The new mall is cursed.
: Hey, those old people listen to the same music as you. You’re suddenly way less cool than I thought you were.
: I’m surprised you ever thought I was cool in the first place. I don’t have any rings on and that’s the key indicator of that.
: You have earrings. They’re just normally obscured by your hair. So it’s sort of like there’s been a hint of coolness just looming in the background that is now gone because of old people.
: Why do old people always have to ruin everything? Why can’t they just leave us alone and not listen to our music or take our cell phones away because we’re trying to sext adults?
: I think lumping your mom in with other old people is a little unfair to her when she’s the same age as you mentally.
: True. But she’s seemed weirdly positive lately if you take away all the stuff about me liking you. I wonder if she finally met somebody?
: Not a clue. I have nothing to do with this or her and don’t know anything about that.
: That’s good. Because if I found out she wound up sleeping with you or something-
: OH MY GOD!
: I can’t believe you slept with my mom! Even if I told you to sleep with my mom! That was so long ago! You were supposed to forget about it!
: In my defense, she was extremely drunk.
: I don’t think you know what “defense” means!
: Also, why did they give us squid again?! All we asked for was coffee this time! There’s no way they misheard that too!
: Rin, I’m sorry about the whole...sleeping with your mom thing. But, on the bright side, I have no problems with you calling me “Daddy” from now on.
: She’s so old, though. Like, how did you even do it without breaking her hip or something?
: Oh, easy. She was on top and got to control the pace.
: Be more vague! I didn’t ask for specifics!
: At least the first time. The second, I got to be the one in charge.
: There was a second?!
: A third and fourth and fifth too, yeah. I don’t know if you’d count those ones, though, since Imani was there too.
: That’s-
: Actually, that’s kind of hot. Very hot. Miss Imai is so pretty. It should have been me there in place of my mom.
: Yeah, I think Imani’s a little less enthusiastic about having sex with teenagers than I am.
: I kind of figured based simply on the fact that she hasn’t hooked up with Kirin yet despite having over a thousand opportunities to do just that.
: What does this mean for the future, though? Like, was it just a one or...I guess a two night stand thing? You’re not going to keep doing it are you? That could impact our friendship.
: Could it?
: I mean, yeah. Like, she obviously doesn’t want me seeing you. So if we’re both seeing you, things could get even messier.
: I might even lose my laptop next time. And if I lose my laptop, that means no more porn. And if I lose access to porn, that means I’ll need to use Futaba’s laptop for porn.

: And if I use Futaba’s laptop for porn, she’ll find a bunch of lesbian stuff in her history, accidentally click on something, and begin the slow and painful conversion into lesbianism, thus destroying the entire space time continuum and life as we know it.
: So if I keep having sex with your mom, it will destroy the universe?
: Basically, yeah.
: Wow. I’ll be sure to keep that in mind the next time I’m having sex with your mom.
: Please do. That’s all I-
: Wait a second! Would you seriously destroy the space time continuum for sex with some old lady?!   Shouldn’t you be a little more careful, maybe?!
: Destroying the space time continuum would actually be a huge plus for me. So if boning Rika is the key to solving the mysteries of the universe, I will bone her as many times as it takes.
: God damn it. I can’t believe I’m going to eventually sleep with the same guy as my mom. I’ve seen so many videos with this same exact plot line before.
: Thanks for not getting mad at me. Even if the lack of anger is the direct result of having sex with so many other people that you care about.
: Yeah, the Chika thing was honestly way worse than this. But the Chika thing is a whole other thing lately and now I’m just kind of burnt out.
: A whole “other” thing as in what, exactly? Because I will also agree that she is crazy now and this may or may not be my fault.
: I don’t think you have much to do with this apart from just me also liking you, really. We’re just...going through a bit of a...spat right now.
: Well, is it anything I can help with? Because Chika still listens to me to a...certain extent. And I can promise you I won’t have sex with her in order to extract information by sensual force.
: At this rate, I might have to extract information from her by sensual force. Whatever “sensual force” means.
: Now that I would like to see.
: Would you really, though?
: Because I know it’s easy to say that, but I also know it was probably hell watching me get invested in other people when you knew way before me that we were a little more than just friends.
: I’m not going to fault you for trying to date girls your age, Rin. Nor am I going to fault you for taking so long to get on the same page as me.
: And yes, I would probably be upset if I had to share you. And yes, I acknowledge that it’s entirely unreasonable for me to expect you to reject the same infidelity that I partake in daily.
: However...if you strapped me to a chair and forced me to watch you and Chika lez out on each other, my arousal would be undeniable. Sad, yes. But undeniable.
: Kind of like how I felt watching you and Sana from behind the curtain at Ayane’s place.
: Oh, right. I forgot that happened.
: It’s fine, Sensei. I shouldn’t be relying on other people to solve my problems for me. This is something I can handle on my own.

: True. But if I am loosely involved as you claim due to the fact that you also like me now, we can find a way to leverage that and potentially provide you the opportunity to act on it and confront your issues with Chika.
: What, like...have her see us together and then get offended by my forwardness?
: Basically, yeah.
: You think that would work?
: I don’t think it wouldn’t work?
